summary: Full-extraction pass over 15 stored Korean enforcement decrees (law.go.kr XML): the Anti-Corruption Act decree 2005, five ACRC Act decree versions 2008-2026, six Public Interest Whistleblower Protection Act decree versions 2011-2026 and three Public Funds Recovery Act decree versions 2020-2026. They hold rules, not statistics: no observations. Added 41 rules (award caps, minimum reward amounts, up-front payment shares, relief limits, proxy filing, reduction limits, scope) and 10 events, dated from the decrees' amendment marks and addenda; rules restated unchanged in later versions were recorded once. All annexes are text in the XML (no OCR needed).

program_rules.applies_to: monetary award (포상금) for self-disclosure: a person who received money or goods and reported them (art. 35(1) ground 4), Anti-Corruption Act decree from 30 Dec 2005
program_rules.quote: 제1항제4호에 해당하는 경우 포상금은 신고금액의 20퍼센트 범위 내로 하되, 2억원 이하로 한다
program_rules.notes: Self-disclosure award: at most 20% of the amount reported and at most 2억원. Korean amounts read with 억 = 100,000,000, 천만 = 10,000,000, 만 = 10,000 (compound units multiply, e.g. 2억 = 200,000,000; 5천만 = 50,000,000; 30만 = 300,000); value recorded in KRW at scale 1 as existing Korean rule rows do. valid_to from kor-moleg-acrc-decree-2015 (raised to 30% and 5억원 for reports received from 20 Oct 2015); the 2008 ACRC decree (art. 71(3)) kept the same text.

events.title: Monetary awards for corruption reports set at up to KRW 50 million, or up to 20% (KRW 200 million) for self-disclosure
events.description: The amended Anti-Corruption Act decree creates monetary awards (포상금) for reports that bring a public benefit without a revenue recovery: up to KRW 50 million in general, and up to 20% of the amount reported (at most KRW 200 million) for officials who report money or goods they received.
events.quote: 신고금액 및 신고유형에 따라 차등하여 포상금을 지급할 수 있도록 함

events.title: ACRC Act decree replaces the Anti-Corruption Act decree
events.description: With the Act on the Establishment of the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission (Act 8878, 29 Feb 2008), the new decree (Presidential Decree 20737) repeals the Anti-Corruption Act decree and moves the reward rules to arts. 71-83 unchanged: rewards 20% down to 4% (annex 1), cap KRW 2 billion, awards up to KRW 50 million (self-disclosure up to 20%, KRW 200 million).
events.quote: 국민고충처리위원회의 고충민원처리와 국가청렴위원회의 부패방지활동 및 국무총리 행정심판위원회의 기능을 통합하여

events.title: Corruption award cap raised from KRW 50 million to KRW 100 million
events.description: An amendment of the ACRC Act decree (Presidential Decree 21513) raises the cap on monetary awards (포상금) for corruption reports from KRW 50 million to KRW 100 million, for reports received after it takes effect.
events.quote: 제71조제2항의 개정규정은 부칙 제1조 본문에 따른 제71조제2항의 개정규정의 시행 후 최초로 접수된 신고부터 적용한다

events.title: Corruption award cap raised to KRW 200 million and reward cap to KRW 3 billion
events.description: The amended ACRC Act decree raises the cap on monetary awards (포상금) for corruption reports from KRW 100 million to KRW 200 million and the reward (보상금) cap from KRW 2 billion to KRW 3 billion, for reports received from 20 Oct 2015.
events.quote: 포상금의 상한액을 1억원에서 2억원으로, 보상금의 상한액을 20억원에서 30억원으로 각각 상향조정하고

events.title: ACRC Act decree: fines count toward corruption rewards; self-disclosure award ends; relief decisions within 90 days
events.description: The 15 Oct 2019 amendment of the ACRC Act decree (in force 17 Oct 2019) adds fines, petty fines, surcharges and fines for negligence to the amounts that earn a reward (for reports made from that date), deletes the separate award for self-disclosure of bribes, and requires relief (구조금) applications to be decided within 90 days.
events.quote: 제72조제1항제5호의 개정규정은 이 영 시행 이후 부패행위 신고를 하는 경우부터 적용한다

events.title: PIWPA decree enacted: 169 laws covered, rewards 20% down to 4%, cap KRW 1 billion
events.description: The first Enforcement Decree of the Public Interest Whistleblower Protection Act (Presidential Decree 23198) takes effect with the Act: it lists 169 covered laws, sets rewards from 20% down to 4% of the recovered amount (annex 2), a KRW 1 billion cap, and relief decisions within 90 days.
events.quote: 「공익신고자 보호법」이 제정(법률 제10472호, 2011. 3. 29. 제정, 9. 30. 시행)됨에 따라

events.title: Minimum public-interest reward raised: rewards of KRW 200,000 or less not paid
events.description: An amendment of the PIWPA decree (Presidential Decree 25586) changes the minimum reward: rewards computed at KRW 200,000 or less are no longer paid (previously below KRW 100,000), for reports made from 2 Sep 2014. The same amendment lets relief (구조금) be cut or refused on the grounds used for rewards.
events.quote: 이 영 시행 전에 공익신고를 한 자에 대한 해당 공익신고와 관련한 보상금의 지급에 관하여는 제22조제3항의 개정규정에도 불구하고 종전의 규정에 따른다

events.title: Monetary awards for public-interest reports created, capped at KRW 200 million
events.description: The amended PIWPA decree sets the grounds for monetary awards (포상금) for public-interest reports (including fines or surcharges imposed and prevention of social disasters) and caps them at KRW 200 million.

events.title: PIWPA decree: rewards up to 30%, award cap KRW 500 million, minimum reward KRW 300,000
events.description: The amended PIWPA decree raises the reward schedule from 20% to 30% of the recovered amount at the top rate (30% down to 4%), raises the monetary award cap from KRW 200 million to KRW 500 million, raises the amount below which rewards are not paid from KRW 200,000 to KRW 300,000, and specifies when up to 50% of a reward may be paid first. Reports made before 19 Dec 2023 keep the old rules.

events.title: PIWPA decree removes the KRW 3 billion reward cap; legal-aid costs for internal whistleblowers
events.description: Implementing Act 20243 (6 Feb 2024), the amended PIWPA decree removes the KRW 3 billion cap on rewards for internal whistleblowers and sets how lawyers who assist internal whistleblowers are paid by the ACRC and how wrongly paid costs are clawed back.
events.quote: 종전에 30억원으로 설정한 내부 공익신고자에 대한 보상금의 지급한도액을 없애는

gaps: Rules restated unchanged in later consolidated decree versions were recorded once, from the version that introduced them (or the earliest stored version that prints them), not again from every later version; the ledger says which. If every version should carry its own row, that is a decision for the main session.

Several amending decrees are not stored (2009-05-28, 2014-09-02, 2019-10-15, 2022-02-18, 2022-07-19, 2023-12-19 for the ACRC Act and Public Funds Recovery Act decrees); their changes were dated from amendment marks and addenda in later consolidated versions. The ACRC Act minimum reward (KRW 300,000) has no start date because of this: the 2022 addendum refers to KRW 200,000.

Possible conflict: kor-acrc-ar-2014 rows (sanctions_threshold KRW 500,000 to 1,000,000 from 2014-09-02, and the matching event) describe the 2 Sep 2014 change as a minimum penalty, while the PIWPA decree (kor-moleg-piwpa-decree-2016, art. 22(3) and addendum 2014.9.2) shows a change in the minimum reward (below KRW 100,000 to KRW 200,000 or less). Worth a check of the report wording.

Suggested correction: rule r-8ebdd004b6 (award cap KRW 50 million, kor-moleg-acad-decree-2005) has no valid_to; kor-moleg-acrc-decree-2014 shows it was raised to KRW 100 million on 28 May 2009, so valid_to could be 2009-05-27.

Proposed rule types (not in DATA_MODEL): award_min_amount, award_partial_payment_pct, reward_basis_includes_fines, relief_wage_cap_multiple, relief_wage_loss_max_months, award_reduction_max_pct, covered_laws_count.

ledger.contains: Anti-Corruption Act Enforcement Decree as amended by Presidential Decree 19238 (in force 30 Dec 2005), full consolidated text (53 articles, 2 annexes, addenda, amending text, reason statement). Programme content: monetary awards (포상금, art. 35: up to KRW 50 million; self-disclosure up to 20% of the amount reported and KRW 200 million), reward grounds (art. 35-2; fines and penalties excluded), Reward Committee (9 members), reward schedule (annex 1: 20% up to 1억, then 14%, 10%, 6%, 4%), cap KRW 2 billion (art. 40(3)), no reward for audit/investigation officials on their own duties (art. 41; the earlier 50% cut for other officials is gone), joint reports, payment after recovery with up to 50% withheld until recovery starts (art. 44), clawback; addendum: new schedule applies to reports received after the decree. Already in the data: cap KRW 2 billion, award cap KRW 50 million, top 20% and bottom 4%, the 2005-12-30 event. Added: self-disclosure award caps (KRW 200 million and 20%), withholding share, fines-excluded flag, an event for the awards. Out of scope throughout: the commission's organisation and complaint handling, protection procedures and their deadlines (60-day protection decisions, 7-day objections, etc.), penalty schedules (fines for negligence 과태료, non-compliance charges 이행강제금, surcharges on fraudsters 제재부가금), employment limits and citizen audit requests. Intermediate bands of the reward schedules are not separate rows (only top and bottom rates, as earlier passes did); the 1,000-won rounding rule is not recorded.

First Enforcement Decree of the ACRC Act (Presidential Decree 20737, in force 29 Feb 2008), full text (92 articles, 2 annexes, addenda, reason statement). Programme content: reporting and protection (arts. 54-70), awards and rewards (arts. 71-83) with the same rules as the 2005 Anti-Corruption Act decree under new numbers: awards up to KRW 50 million (self-disclosure 20%, KRW 200 million), rewards 20%-4% (annex 1), cap KRW 2 billion (art. 77(3)), 50% withholding, fines excluded; Reward Committee now 7 members. These unchanged rules are already recorded from kor-moleg-acad-decree-2005 (whose rows run to 2015), so they are not repeated here. Added: event for the new decree replacing the Anti-Corruption Act decree. Out of scope throughout: the commission's organisation and complaint handling, protection procedures and their deadlines (60-day protection decisions, 7-day objections, etc.), penalty schedules (fines for negligence 과태료, non-compliance charges 이행강제금, surcharges on fraudsters 제재부가금), employment limits and citizen audit requests. Intermediate bands of the reward schedules are not separate rows (only top and bottom rates, as earlier passes did); the 1,000-won rounding rule is not recorded.
